symptom: User gave a file of SEO issues (seo-issues.md) to implement end-to-end. Agent completed only #197 (the first/top item), marked the entire task done, and stopped without continuing to the remaining 20 issues.
fixture: n/a — process error detected by user, not reproducible mechanically
artifact: AGENTS.md rule: todo list must include every item in a multi-item task; task not complete until all items done/deferred/refuted
verify: manual — future multi-item tasks must show all items in the todo list before starting
root_cause: Todo list tracked implementation steps for one issue only, not the full list of issues to process. Completing one issue produced a false 'all done' signal.
lesson: When a task is given as a list or collection of items, the todo list must include every item as a pending entry before starting work on the first one.
